cloud_agent_create_starting: Cloud computer is starting. You can create once it's ready.
cloud_agent_create_start_deferred: Your Agent was created, but could not start. Try again to start the same Agent.
cloud_agent_create_refresh_error: Your Agent was created, but the lists could not refresh. Try again to open the same Agent.
agent_create_local_description: Runs on your own computer, ready to chat as soon as it’s made. Keep the computer online to use it.
external_agent_credential_hint: Shown only now. Whoever holds it acts as {name}; revoke it from {name}'s profile.
external_agent_discard_body: The agent and its credential are deleted.
external_agent_discard_failed: Couldn't discard the agent. Try again.
external_agent_credential_replace_body: Whatever signed in with it disconnects until {name} gets the new one. This can't be undone.
external_agent_credential_revoke_body: It stops working at once. This can't be undone.
external_agent_credential_rate_limited: Too many credentials were created recently. Try again in {minutes} min.
external_agent_disabled_note: Disabled. Connect a machine again to re-enable.
device_verify_not_authorized: You cannot approve this code. Ask the Agent's owner or a Workspace admin.
device_verify_agent_not_external: This Agent is not an external Agent.
device_verify_agent_unavailable: This Agent is unavailable or disabled.
device_verify_credential_limit: This Agent already holds as many active keys as it can. Revoke one first.
device_verify_agent_not_found: No external Agent with that name exists in that Workspace.
device_verify_mint_rate_limited: Too many keys were created recently. Try again in a few minutes.
device_verify_external_title: Give this machine an Agent key?
device_verify_external_description: The machine showing code {code} will act as the Agent you choose, until its key is revoked.
device_verify_external_choose: Which Agent is this key for?
device_verify_external_none: You can't give a key to any external Agent. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
cloud_agent_create_private_note: A new cloud Agent is private by default: only you can chat with it. To add it to a channel, first make it public on its profile page.
external_agent_step_credential: 2. When it asks for a credential, give it this one
external_agent_credential_keep_out: Keep it out of commands and files.
external_agent_finish_later: You can come back to connect it later.
external_agent_state_waiting_hint: This changes on its own once {name} signs in.
external_agent_state_no_credential_hint: It has no credential yet. Create one below and hand it to {name}.
external_agent_state_connected_hint: {name} signed in to CoForge. You can close this.
external_agent_state_offline_hint: Its credential still works. Messages wait for it to come back.
external_agent_state_disconnected_hint: Its credentials were all revoked. Create a new one and hand it to {name} to reconnect.
external_agent_ask_for_credential: To connect it, ask {owner} for a credential.
